business_summary: Fino Payments Bank Limited provides financial solutions and services in India. The company offers savings, current, and salary accounts; personal, home and property, gold, and referral loans; debit and prepaid cards; and life, health, general, motor, and shopkeeper insurance products, as well as fixed deposit and sweep account facility. It also provides cash management services to various sectors, such as micro-finance, banking, logistics, e-commerce, agri-tech, and retail as well as mobile banking through the FinoPay app. In addition, the company offers loan referrals, business correspondent using the Aadhaar authentication, domestic money transfer, and micro ATM services, Aadhaar Pay; and bill payment and recharges. The company was formerly known as Fino Fintech Limited and changed its name to Fino Payments Bank Limited in April 2017. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India. Fino Payments Bank Limited is a subsidiary of FINO PayTech Limited.
